NAME: raw
DESCRIPTION: Traffic not classified as anything else.

NAME: unfiltered
DESCRIPTION: (Internet) traffic that must go directly to the destination (from a client endpoint) without passing through ZTNA/MEP

NAME: http-no-proxy
DESCRIPTION: Traffic that is http but should never go through an http proxy.

NAME: http-proxy
DESCRIPTION: Traffic that is http and is compatible with an http proxy.

NAME: http-wss
DESCRIPTION: Traffic is an http websocket supported by the proxy.
